enforced_by: the copywriter and the video teardown read it; nothing refuses an unknown value
note: One list per dial — humour, delivery style, register, pacing, reference world, avoid; the asset is the dial.

rows.name: fast-open-slow-body
rows.what: The first beats move hard, then the piece slows down where the thinking has to happen.

extra.when: A mechanism or a proof that needs room, in a placement that gives nothing away for free.

rows.name: escalating
rows.what: Each beat shorter and closer than the one before, all the way to the close.

extra.when: Agitation into the offer, where the pressure is the argument.

rows.name: one-breath
rows.what: The whole piece delivered as a single unbroken run — no cut, no pause, nowhere to get off.

extra.when: Short pieces whose whole appeal is that nothing was edited.

rows.name: beat-and-pause
rows.what: A line, then a held silence long enough to be uncomfortable, then the next line.

extra.when: Deadpan and deadly-sincere reads, where the silence is what makes the line land.

rows.name: list-stack
rows.what: Items delivered in a run, the same shape each time, the repetition doing the work.

extra.when: Failed solutions, proof and the offer, where quantity is itself the argument.
